Prevention: KALRO Embu and nurseries registered by
KEPHIS Avoid plant injury during transplanting
Avoid planting near related crops e.g. tomatoes, eggplants, potatoes
Maintain optimal crop fertility by applying manure and fertilizer as per soil test recommendation to ensure plant vigour
If irrigating, do it early in the morning to ensure drying of the foliage to lower humidity.
Destroy and bury infected crop debris 3 feet deep after harvesting
Rotate crop with non-Solanaceae family plants e.g. maize, beans and peas for at least 2 seasons
Monitoring: Small dark brown to black spots on lower shaded leaves, stems and fruit
Spots that are brown and leathery with faint concentric rings, which later become uneven
Take control measures when one plant shows spots.
Direct Control: Prune and destroy by burying affected leaves and old leaves 3 feet deep, to reduce inculum.
Copper-based fungicide e.g. copper oxychloride (Amicop 50WP or
Restrictions: Always wear protective clothing when using pesticides.
Follow the instructions on the product label, such as dosage, timing of application, pre-harvest interval, maximum number of sprays, restricted re-entry interval
Always consult recent list of registered pesticides (PCPB)
U (unlikely to present acute hazard in normal use).
